prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: photoreal 3D character animator reference, HUMAN HANDS AND ARMS HOLDING SWORD AND SHIELD, not standalone weapons.
Input image role: the attached original four first-person poses is the user's visual and material reference only.
Create a high resolution landscape 3 columns by 2 rows sheet. Six clean equal panels. One identical adult mercenary and equipment in ALL panels: RIGHT hand grips a slender single-handed steel sword, LEFT hand and forearm strapped into a round oak/iron shield. Worn dark leather fingerless gloves, natural exposed fingertips, flexible charcoal cloth sleeves and fitted brown leather forearm bracers with two modest buckles. Real skin wrinkles, articulated knuckles, no bulky pipe-shaped forearms. Wrist and forearm align naturally, thumb opposes fingers and rests firmly over index, four fingers individually curl around the sword handle. Left forearm passes through the broad cuff; left hand wraps the narrow vertical rear grip. No floating grip, no hand going through board.
Subject pose: relaxed combat READY with both elbows bent about 100 degrees near lower ribs, shoulders relaxed, shield carried low in front-left, sword hilt in front-right of lower chest and point angled up and slightly inward. It is the SAME held pose photographed from multiple camera angles, not six separate weapons.
Panel 1 POV: first-person player's eye, both hands/forearms at lower corners, low left shield shows inner wood and straps, upright right sword. Match the reference's natural believable hand shape, arm size and dark medieval material quality.
Panel 2 TOP: character upper torso from directly above, include shoulders, bent elbows, wrists, both held weapons, full blade, so contact and spatial relationship are clear.
Panel 3 BOTTOM: same complete upper-body pose from below, see palms, undersides of forearms, grip, shield enarmes.
Panel 4 LEFT: orthographic left-side upper torso, BOTH connected arms and actual held objects.
Panel 5 RIGHT: orthographic right-side upper torso, BOTH connected arms and actual held objects.
Panel 6 GRIP DETAIL: close-up pair showing right hand's realistic firm sword grasp and left hand's firm shield rear-strap grasp, wrist anatomy and all finger contacts clearly legible.
Neutral dark gray studio, soft readable lighting, no motion blur. Torso chest-up, omit head detail and legs; arms MUST remain visibly connected to shoulders in external views. Equipment grounded functional medieval, no oversized fantasy pieces. Small labels exactly POV, TOP, BOTTOM, LEFT, RIGHT, GRIP DETAIL. Do not replace character views with weapon turnarounds. Detailed AAA natural anatomy and believable pressure on grips.
review: Grip/anatomy identity approved; directional labels are not reliable: top/bottom foreshortening and duplicated side orientation need separate corrected view generation.
